Pomegranate Dressing
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 4:00am

Ingredients




cup Pomegranate juice
cup Extra virgin olive oil
1 tablespoon Lemon juice
2 teaspoons Fresh mint, chopped
teaspoon Dry mustard
teaspoon Salt

Preparation

1 In jar with tight-fitting lid, combine pomegranate juice, olive oil, lemon juice, fresh mint, dry mustard and salt. Cover and shake until well mixed. 2 NOTES : Serve with Orange-Onion Salad (see recipe).
